welcome.title: Welcome to Larmony!
welcome.body: Let's take a quick tour of the sidebar so you know where everything in your household lives.

overview.title: Overview
overview.body: Your household's summary: this month's balance, budgets, goals, and upcoming bills, all in one place.

transactions.title: Transactions
transactions.body: Every income and expense logged for the household, with filters by month, category, and type.

categories.title: Categories
categories.body: Categories organize your transactions, budgets, and recurrences. Your household starts with 13 default categories.

budgets.title: Budgets
budgets.body: Set a monthly spending limit per category and track how much has been spent.

goals.title: Goals
goals.body: Create savings goals with a target amount and log contributions until you reach it.

scheduledTransactions.title: Scheduled entries
scheduledTransactions.body: Register recurring bills and entries — post them manually with an email reminder, or let Larmony generate them automatically on the due date.

reports.title: Reports
reports.body: Monthly and yearly charts showing how your household's finances evolve.

settings.title: Settings
settings.body: Manage your household's information and invite other members.

intro.title: Your household overview
intro.body: This dashboard gives you a quick summary: this month's balance, budgets, goals, and upcoming bills. It fills in as you use Larmony.

intro.title: Transactions
intro.body: This is where every income and expense for the household lives. Use the filters to find entries by month, category, or type.

new.title: New transaction
new.body: Click here to log an income or expense at any time.

intro.title: How to log a transaction
intro.body: Fill in the basics, then use the fields below to categorize, split into installments, or divide the expense with other members of the household.

category.title: Category
category.body: Classify the transaction (e.g., Groceries, Transport) so it shows up correctly in reports and budgets. It's optional.

person.title: Person
person.body: Who actually made the expense — different from who's registering it. Per-person reports use this field. If left blank, it defaults to you.

installments.title: Installments
installments.body: Turn this on to split the total amount into several monthly installments. Larmony creates one transaction per installment, linked to the same series.

split.title: Split between members
split.body: Turn this on to divide the amount among household members, either equally or with a specific value for each.

intro.title: Categories
intro.body: Categories classify your transactions, budgets, and recurrences. Your household starts with 13 default categories, and you can create your own.

intro.title: Budgets
intro.body: Set a monthly spending limit per category. Larmony automatically calculates how much has been spent and warns you when you go over.

intro.title: Goals
intro.body: Create savings goals with a target amount and, optionally, a date. Log contributions over time until you reach the goal.

intro.title: Scheduled entries
intro.body: Register recurring bills and entries — choose between posting them manually (with an email reminder) or letting Larmony generate the transaction automatically on the right date.

postingMode.title: Post automatically
postingMode.body: Turn this on for Larmony to create the transaction on its own, on each occurrence date. Leave it off to get a reminder and post it yourself, confirming the amount at that moment.

frequency.title: Frequency
frequency.body: Sets the entry's cadence (weekly, monthly, or yearly) and, in the "Every" field, how many periods apart it repeats — e.g. monthly every 1, or weekly every 2 for biweekly.

reminder.title: Reminder
reminder.body: Manual mode only: how many days before the due date Larmony emails you so you don't forget to post it.

intro.title: Reports
intro.body: Track how your household's finances evolve with monthly and yearly charts, spending by category, and spending by person.

intro.title: Settings
intro.body: This is where you manage your household's information.

members.title: Members
members.body: Invite other people to manage the household's finances with you. Every member can log and view transactions, budgets, and goals.
